{"command":"function Inflate-GitObject([string]$path) {
  $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path)
  # strip 2-byte zlib header and 4-byte adler trailer
  $payload = New-Object byte[] ($bytes.Length - 6)
  [Array]::Copy($bytes, 2, $payload, 0, $payload.Length)
  $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream (,$payload)
  $ds = New-Object System.IO.Compression.DeflateStream ($ms, [System.IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)
  $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader ($ds)
  $text = $sr.ReadToEnd()
  $sr.Close(); $ds.Close(); $ms.Close()
  return $text
}

while ($i -lt $raw.Length) {
  $sp = [Array]::IndexOf($raw, [byte]0x20, $i)
  $mode = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($raw, $i, $sp - $i)
  $nul = [Array]::IndexOf($raw, [byte]0x00, $sp + 1)
  $name = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($raw, $sp + 1, $nul - $sp - 1)

  $i = $nul + 21
}
